To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the requirements of a messaging system for the Internet differ from those of a parallel system, and that the performance requirements for Internet applications are much more stringent.
the performance of messaging systems is limited by network latencies and that the key to high performance in messaging is to reduce network latencies by exploiting the locality of communication.

the performance of messaging systems is determined by the hardware latency of the network and the performance of the messaging system can be significantly improved by the use of asynchronous message passing.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, implementation, and evaluation of a new class of middleware systems for distributed and parallel applications that we call messaging systems.
the development of scalable, reliable, secure and efficient middleware for distributed and parallel computing, and its applications in a variety of domains.
the design, implementation and evaluation of middleware systems for distributed computing, including Grid and Web Services.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
message based architectures are more appropriate for distributed systems than connection based ones.
the Internet and Grids are not yet ready for prime time for real time applications.
messaging is a key enabler of parallel computing, the Internet, and the Grid.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
messaging systems can be built for parallel and distributed systems with the same ease and performance as for the Internet and the grid.
we have shown that messaging systems can provide the same performance as connection based systems, but with a much simpler and more flexible architecture.
we are building a middleware for the Internet that is as powerful as the middleware for the Grid.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a messaging system is a critical element in the construction of a parallel and distributed computing infrastructure and is an essential element in the Grid.
the Internet is not a parallel computer.
messaging systems are a key technology for Grids and for the Internet of the future.
